brief:
**BLUF:** No major law enforcement incidents, fires, or severe weather reported in Tazewell County or immediate surroundings in the last 24 hours. Recent local developments include Tazewell County’s new consolidated volunteer fire company becoming operational and a crash on US-460 in Bluefield WV on Saturday evening. High school football results from Friday night featured Richlands defeating Tazewell.[[1]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
- A multi-vehicle crash occurred on US-460 West (Big Laurel Hwy) at US-52 (E Cumberland Rd) in Bluefield, Mercer County WV, on Saturday evening around 4:59 p.m. EDT; no injuries or lane closures details reported beyond the incident. [OSINT - WEB][[2]](https://x.com/WV511South/status/2114099432815751233)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
- Tazewell County’s new consolidated volunteer fire company (merging 11 departments into stations under one entity) became operational on or around Oct. 15 to address recruitment and funding challenges; a paid part-time department is planned for spring 2027. [OSINT - WEB][[1]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)
- Tazewell County Public Service Authority seeks bids for the Pocahontas Waterline Replacement Project (water mains, hydrants, etc., in Mercer County WV areas); bids due Nov. 19, 2026, with pre-bid meeting Nov. 2. [OSINT - WEB][[3]](https://wvlegals.com/public-notice-36041/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell County Public Library events: Pocahontas Halloween Party (Oct. 27, 3:30 p.m. EDT); Meet the Candidates (Oct. 29, 7 p.m. EDT in Tazewell). [OSINT - WEB][[4]](https://www.locable.com/connections/81466-tazewell-county-chamber-of-commerce/events/)
- Town of Richlands Trick or Treat (Oct. 31, 5:30–8 p.m. EDT); ribbon cutting for The Burnout in North Tazewell (Oct. 31, 3 p.m. EDT). [OSINT - WEB][[4]](https://www.locable.com/connections/81466-tazewell-county-chamber-of-commerce/events/)
